how: the hand argument for steps of every length, read line by line and each step checked: a step preserves parity and sends a corner's class to plus or minus a corner's class (conjugation by an odd element is -1 on H_1 of the even part: a(ab)a = ba, a(bc)a = (ab)(ca)); a matrix of GL(2, Z) that sends a non-zero vector to plus or minus itself has an eigenvalue +-1 and is not hyperbolic (also by enumeration, checks/web_wf7_on_main.py X3: none of the 2,344 hyperbolic matrices with entries to 12 has one); a matrix permuting two or three lines that span the plane has a power equal to +-1. So a face with a corner of non-zero class admits no hyperbolic step, at any length; the half-turn face's one corner has class 0 and it has hyperbolic steps
note: The argument is elementary and complete for the four faces as defined. It assumes, as the note says, that a history step must respect the face (its letter types and corners).
